title: TraceSampler: Making Sampling Errors Predictable and Correctable for Accelerated Generative Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.14332v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate sampling from continuous-time generative models can require many model evaluations. Low-step sampling reduces cost, but coarse updates introduce endpoint errors that can accumulate and degrade generation quality. We introduce TraceSampler, a post-training method that corrects these errors without modifying the pretrained model. Rather than optimising low-step updates directly, TraceSampler models endpoint error as a sample-specific prediction problem. A higher-step reference integration over the same interval provides the supervised target, while a compact representation makes high-dimensional error predictable from the sampling trace. This representation combines shared residual structure, trace-derived directions, and a low-rank remainder, so shallow per-step MLP heads predict sample-dependent coefficients. These coefficients drive a two-stage learned residual correction: the first stage predicts the full endpoint residual,

translated_title: TraceSampler：使加速生成采样中的采样误差可预测且可纠正
translated_abstract: 从连续时间生成模型中进行准确采样往往需要多次模型评估。低步数采样可以降低成本，但粗粒度的更新会引入端点误差，这些误差会不断累积并降低生成质量。我们提出了 TraceSampler，这是一种无需修改预训练模型即可纠正这些误差的训练后方法。TraceSampler 并不直接优化低步数更新，而是将端点误差建模为一个特定于样本的预测问题。对相同区间进行更高步数的参考积分提供了监督目标，而一种紧凑的表示方法使高维误差可以从采样轨迹中被预测出来。该表示结合了共享残差结构、由轨迹导出的方向以及低秩余量，使得浅层的逐步 MLP 头能够预测依赖于样本的系数。这些系数驱动一个两阶段学习的残差校正：第一阶段预测完整的端点残差，
tldr: 提出 TraceSampler，一种无需修改预训练模型的训练后方法，通过将低步数采样的端点误差建模为特定于样本的预测问题，并利用紧凑表示和两阶段残差校正，使加速生成采样中的误差变得可预测且可纠正。
en_tdlr: TraceSampler is a post-training method that corrects endpoint errors from low-step accelerated sampling in continuous-time generative models without modifying the pretrained model, by modeling error as a sample-specific prediction problem with a compact representation and two-stage learned residual correction.
